notes_for_editor: Only one record found: the Land Information Ontario tower layer (name, fire-detection purpose, location note, no power, verified date). No source explains the MMR abbreviation. The record's general comment (used in the story) says no picture was taken of the tower and that it has not been on NRVIS; no source explains NRVIS, and the comment's typos are kept out of the story. Two YouTube videos (titles 'Visting old abandoned Pakashkan Fire Tower' and 'Last visit to Unstable Old Fire Tower Adventure North West Ontario') describe an old tower near Pakashkan Lake as abandoned and unstable and show climbing. Their text could not be read and it is not confirmed they describe this tower, so they are not used; the story does not encourage climbing. A NWONewsWatch story dated 15 July 2026 reports wildfire damage at Pakashkan Lake Lodge and does not mention the tower; the editor may want to check whether the tower was affected. The brief has no local_unit, so the story says Ontario only.
